finalText:
**The build works again.** You were right, two warnings hid real breaks.

1. `src/core/options.js` read `options.retries`. The new bundler sends `retryCount`. It now takes either one.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw when `backoffEnabled` was unset. Unset now means off, as before.

Build exits 0. The 8 warnings left are old-API notices, just noise.
